about: Fuel (WASM instructions) per call under SpacetimeDB 2.14.1's wasmtime config, for gate.sh. Set 2026-11-09 on rhai-1 from the measured numbers with about 25% headroom: rates 7,031 (the authority's call: one answer per state, finished per body), rates-law 127,454 (the law itself), strike 247,041 (check + done), cooldown 1,694 (a number by name), perceived 59,088. Before rhai-1: rates 309,451, strike 578,264, cooldown 20,656, perceived 61,121. Raise a budget only with the measurement that justifies it (docs/SCRIPT_ENGINES.md). Added 2026-11-10 on rules-2: hook 446,967 (on_give over a giver's agreement, demand and regard; docs/WORLD_RULES.md), budget 560,000. The same run measured rates 7,183, rates-law 138,010, strike 274,912 and perceived 62,671 against main's 7,024, 127,901, 269,046 and 60,601 on the same Mac: the new context fields cost up to 5% on the rates path and the larger script 2-3% per call. Added 2026-11-11 on laws-2: senses 3,100 (the authority's call: one answer per state, by night and a torch in the pack), budget 4,000; senses-law 43,497 (the law itself, asked only when a state is new), budget 55,000. The same dev-box run measured rates 7,322, rates-law 120,429, strike 257,207, cooldown 1,704, perceived 53,123 and hook 432,458 against main's 7,312, 120,208, 256,303, 1,694, 52,953 and 431,135 (the script grew by the senses section). moves 1,922 (motion(a) as the authority asks it, one answer per state; the shipped law reads nothing), budget 2,500. After merging main 18aa818b and later (2026-11-11, laws-2): main's larger script raised every law (rates-law 127,459, strike 270,935, hook 446,338) and senses-law to 54,637, against its 55,000; budget 68,000 (25% over the measurement). The authority's call, senses 3,093, did not change. Re-based 2026-11-11 on rates-2: rates-law had been over its 160,000 since main 6593f725 (207,882); the gate runs only by hand, so nothing failed. rates-2 made the law ask cold(a) and wet(a) once each (bit-identical rates, 50,725 states): 209,504 -> 194,609 on the dev-box. Measured on the island at rest (277 people, 33 animals): the law itself is asked 4 to 14 times a minute for the whole world, 58 in the minute after a script install, 0.13-0.22 ms a call in the module, 0.01-0.13 ms a second; the per-tick cost is the rates call (8,585, budget unchanged). Budget 245,000: the measured 194,609 plus 25%, as the others (docs/LIVING_CORE.md, Fuel budgets). The same run measured rates 8,585, strike 274,315, cooldown 1,704, perceived 68,775, hook 448,042, senses 3,139, senses-law 58,604, moves 1,956. After merging lives-3 (rates-2 at 2e9f19d9, the shipped script and the rates path unchanged): rates 8,589, rates-law 218,311, strike 259,737, cooldown 1,704, perceived 64,240, hook 441,450, senses 3,143, senses-law 51,829, moves 1,956; all within budget. The rates-law rise is not explained (probably code generation). Explained 2026-11-11 on tool-8 (docs/LIVING_CORE.md, Fuel budgets): Rhai's hashing keys, drawn at random each time ahash is compiled, moved the fuel of the same source by build (six compiles of main 93019a37: rates-law 197,784 to 215,390, perceived 60,414 to 77,981); lives-3 itself moved rates-law by 1. The bench now fixes the keys, and gate.py measures batches of 64 calls under eight fixed key sets and judges the mean, so the fuel moves only with the code and the fixtures. The gate is the script-gate step of just living-check. Measured on main 93019a37 that way: rates 8,588, rates-law 211,847, strike 266,113, cooldown 1,706, perceived 73,068, hook 443,478, senses 3,145, senses-law 56,571, moves 1,958; all within budget, no budget changed. perceived has the least room (2.6%; five of the eight key sets are over 75,000, up to 81,530). Judged on the game's own keys since det-1 (2026-11-11, docs/LIVING_CORE.md, One hashing seed): the rules fix Rhai's hashing seed for every engine (living_rules::script::HASHING_SEED, the bench's key set 0), and gate.py judges key set 0, the cost the game pays; the mean and range over the eight sets are a diagnostic. Measured on det-1 after merging main 017286a1 (key set 0; the mean over the eight in brackets): rates 8,650 (8,662), rates-law 216,042 (213,462), strike 278,006 (267,921), cooldown 1,706, perceived 78,172 (74,205), hook 438,835 (444,191), senses 3,235, senses-law 72,670 (65,448), moves 2,040. Two laws were over on the game's keys: perceived (75,000; five of eight sets were already over it on tool-8's base) and senses-law (68,000; main's script grew it from 56,571 to 65,448 on the mean since tool-8). Both are asked only for an input the authority has not met since the script revision (perceived_of per RegardIn, regard_of; senses per state), like rates-law; re-based as rates-2 did, the measurement plus 25%: perceived 98,000, senses-law 91,000. Re-based 2026-11-11 on stamina-1 (docs/STAMINA.md): motion(a) now reads the creature's kind (a person runs 1.85 times its walk, animals 1.5; a wolf's approach charges) and two world laws (run_share, run_top), so the authority's call keys the answer by kind: moves 1,958 -> 3,116 (eight fixed key sets, all 3,116), budget 3,900 (the measurement plus 25%). It is still one answer per kind and state, asked at a steering update. The same run measured rates 8,473, rates-law 209,625, strike 287,345 (266,113 on main 93019a37: the breath check and the spend; strike_check no longer asks winded twice and winded reads the pool inline, which brought it down from 344,852), cooldown 1,706, perceived 67,401, hook 447,097, senses 3,275, senses-law 65,384. Re-based 2026-11-12 on stamina-1 after merging main (game's keys judged): strike 310,035 on the game's keys, mean 292,080 over the eight key sets (276,011..310,035), against main 93019a37's 266,113: the breath check (winded, the pool read inline) and the spend (combat_pool, combat_cost from laws) on every strike. Budget 365,000, the mean plus 25% as the others. The strike path runs once per strike's check and release, not per tick.
